messages.subject: Custom function for Descriptives
parts:
I want to add a custom function to Descriptives, say for standard error of mean.  To do this, I add a name for the function, say SE, and the function:
function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x))
but I get an error: Error in descriptive.table(vars = d(var1), data = dataset1,: object 'functions' not found.

What is wrong here?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Custom function for Descriptives
parts:
I don’t see anything wrong (did you type functions instead of function when you actually ran this? For example, I get the following code emited to the console using your function:

descriptive.table(vars = d(mpg),data= mtcars,
func.names =c("Mean","St. Deviation","Valid N"),
func.additional= list(se=function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))))
